description: This file contains utility functions for development testing of project cost API endpoints within a frontend project. It includes functions to fetch project cost data for specific projects and sample IDs, primarily used for debugging or testing purposes.

methods.name: devTryProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches project cost for a given projectId, defaulting to '21566' if none provided. Logs the data to console and returns it.

methods.name: devTrySampleProjectCosts()
methods.description: Fetches project cost data for sample project IDs '21566' and '20684', logs the results as a table, and returns the array of results.
